name: linkding
title: linkding
description: Bookmark manager with tags, full-text search, read-later marks and archive snapshots, plus browser extensions and a REST API. After deploying, sign in with the user name and password you set below.

variables.name: LINKDING_ADMIN_USER
variables.label: Admin user name
variables.description: The first account, made at the first start

variables.name: LINKDING_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.label: Admin password
variables.description: Its password. Only used at the first start: change it later in linkding itself

auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: the browser extensions and API clients sign in with a token (the deploy sheet can still protect it)
